name: @kairo/openclaw-tools
description: OpenClaw tool adapter for the KAIRO domain core.

scripts.plugin:build: npm run build && openclaw plugins build --entry ./dist/entry.js
scripts.plugin:validate: npm run plugin:build && openclaw plugins validate --entry ./dist/entry.js
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/index.test.js dist/entry.test.js dist/gateway-cron.test.js dist/usage-hooks.test.js
